instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Enforce LIGHT MODE only. Hardcode white backgrounds and slate text. Do not use dark mode classes.
Use 'Clash Display' for the main H1 'Free LinkedIn Post Generator (AI-Powered)'.
The Input Field should be massive (text-2xl) and feel like the center of the universe.
The 'Generate' button should have a subtle 'shine' effect on hover.
The Result area must be editable (use a textarea or contentEditable div styled to look like a post).
Use the 'sonner' library for the 'Copied to clipboard' toast.
Implement the loading state with the changing text array defined in components.LoadingState.
Use the provided background image as a subtle fixed background with low opacity (opacity-40) and mix-blend-multiply.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts without tension. Use spacing to create hierarchy.
Always add hover states to interactive elements.
Ensure the backend webhook URL is correctly proxied via FastAPI.
